name: pixel-office
description: Show your Grok Bot or Cursor agent as an NPC in a Pixel Office. Reports only a status, a folder name, and a conversation id to the office's remote MCP server.

PIXEL_OFFICE_URL.title: Pixel Office URL
PIXEL_OFFICE_URL.description: Your office address with no trailing slash. Copy it from Set up your agent > Grok Bot (cloud).

PIXEL_OFFICE_INGEST_TOKEN.title: Pixel Office ingest token (secret)
PIXEL_OFFICE_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Created on Set up your agent > Grok Bot (cloud). Shown once. Keep it here only; never paste it into chat.
